page.overview:
Who is Water Ski Grasshopper?

The Water Ski Grasshopper is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"One grasshopper can't resist a chance to show off to his buddies. "Look at me! I'm barefootin'!" he yells as mosquitoes pull him across a dirty puddle beside the broken sombrero where Hopper and his gang relax between raids."
